Name: Small Room (PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]
[size=3]
It's a real small house. it was the house in the tree in my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30282]Magic Park (PIF)[/url] mod, of course you can put it anywhere you want but you might also want to put it in the tree in that map.
Here you can place beds and mini fridge, the animated fountain works as a water source and the fireplace works for cooking.
Walls and floors are replaceable and decoratable.
[/size][size=3]This mod has two small wooden doors, you buy them from the Magician in the tunnel west of the bus stop.[/size]

[size=3][size=3]Installation:
Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

How do you go about getting it ingame?
Go to [/size][/size][size=3]Magician in the tunnel west of the bus stop and buy a door[/size][size=3][size=3], hang it on the wall, choose the room, and go inside.
You can also use any decorative door as long as it is PIF-enabled.
I created PIF glass doors that are purchased from Robin's store [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]here[/url]
Enjoy! [color=#ff0000]<3[/color]

Remember to install the dependencies or it will not work properly.

[/size][color=#00ffff][size=5]Thank you all for your support! It encourages me to create and share new mods. <3[/size][/color]
